summary: An individual commenter files a short comment in EL26-68 and EL26-71 urging that any cost-allocation or stability method FERC adopts assign burdens to the large loads that cause them, and reserves rights over a proprietary framework she authored.
ask: Consider the comment and take note of the commenter's reservation of rights over her proprietary stability and diagnostic framework.

points.point: The commenter says the public record shows large-load burdens being socialized onto residential and small commercial ratepayers.
points.quote: the burdens created by these loads are being socialized onto residential and small-commercial ratepayers rather than assigned on a cost-causation basis.

points.point: She urges any adopted method to assign burden to the loads that cause it.
points.quote: assigns burden to the loads that cause it and preserves reliability invariants at the point of interconnection.

points.point: She reserves rights over a proprietary framework with pending patent applications and asserts no claim in these dockets.
points.quote: Commenter reserves all rights, including the right to seek appropriate relief in the proper forum.

throughLine.text: A pro se comment captioned in the SPP (EL26-68) and CAISO (EL26-71) show cause dockets that supports cost-causation assignment of large-load burdens and gives notice of a claimed proprietary interest.
